title: Clean-checkout worker preflight and isolated TypeScript regression
businessRules: POST-1C Telegram wire UAT must exercise compiled apps/worker/dist/telegram-polling.js against the same real local HTTP harness; never replace it with a source-only assertion.
Preflight on a clean checkout must compile worker after SQLite Prisma generation and before the complete test suite; no tests may be skipped.
The worker clean-checkout typecheck must run without apps/api/dist but cannot rename or mutate the shared repository's apps/api/dist, as node --test can execute files concurrently.
No schema, business logic, GitHub workflow, UAT threshold, runtime provider configuration or previously green gate may be weakened.
acceptanceCriteria: ci:preflight:local explicitly generates SQLite Prisma client, compiles worker, and then runs full dependency-free suite.
Telegram polling UAT keeps its compiled-worker import and real HTTP assertions.
Worker clean-checkout TypeScript test checks actual tsc against isolated worker source and installed dependency versions with no apps/api/dist, leaving shared build artifacts untouched.
Previous 1706/1708 Ubuntu baseline failures are rerun on exact candidate source and resolved without relaxing UAT; until then this item remains IMPLEMENTATION.
testPlan: npm run workflow:validate && npm run validate:repo && npm run ci:preflight:local

After complete dependencies, confirm tests/post1c-telegram-polling.test.mjs retains a real compiled HTTP wire test and tests/worker-dist-import-runtime.test.mjs proves typecheck without apps/api/dist.
npm run audit:full:repo && npm run uat:pre-github:local; retain GitHub exact-commit PostgreSQL/browser gates and separate human Stage-20 approval.
migrationPlan: No database/schema changes. Compile-order and isolated test fixture correction only.
rollbackPlan: Revert package.json preflight command and two test files plus the regression contract; do not touch data, history, or previously staged financial-hardening changes.
monitoringPlan: Observe full preflight results on the operator's Ubuntu clean repo and exact-source GitHub Actions; record any remaining build/test failure with its original exit code.
securityNotes: Tests use only local HTTP/temporary files, require no real Telegram token, and do not modify tenant data, provider secrets, protected production environments or application permissions.
notes: Operator's fresh repo based on supplied GitHub ZIP passed prepare but ci:preflight:local ended 1706/1708: compiled worker module missing for POST-1C wire suite and shared apps/api/dist precondition falsely asserted by worker typecheck fixture.
The new remote is https://github.com/reyvo1/tokofinal (public web view showed empty repo). No push/commit was performed and no CI/UAT readiness is claimed.
Fix preserves compiled-worker HTTP UAT, starts worker build before full preflight tests, isolates no-dist TypeScript check, and leaves financial patch, database and governance statuses untouched.
